_help: Fill an ad slot by replacing null with one of these. Commit the change and the site updates in a few minutes.
(put the image in the ads/ folder; 300x250 for the sidebar, 728x90 or 320x100 for the inline slots)

Ad network:      { "type": "iframe", "src": "https://the-link-from-the-network-dashboard", "width": 300, "height": 250 }  (its origin must also be added to frame-src in index.html's Content-Security-Policy)
Slots on the page: sidebar (desktop, under the pool), in-feed (phones, under the questions), results-inline (under the results list).
ecosystem: the list on the Ecosystem page (More menu). Add or remove entries freely: { "name", "tagline", "link" (https), "cta" }.
featured: the fixed 'Run your own node' card in the sidebar (not repeated in the Built on Koinos list).
emptySlots: what an unsold slot shows. "none" (default) = nothing at all, the slot takes no space; "ecosystem" = a Koinos project from the list below.
